title: Citadel
summary: Bespoke homelab software. Monitors and controls all devices on my home network, and serves a dashboard for life admin, news, music, a media server, and personal projects. Integrated with several external APIs and local services, accessible on my home network or remotely via Tailscale.

title: Music Companion
summary: A fully interactive archive of my obsession with music. Linking together my physical record collection, digital listening, and gig history.

title: Casino World
summary: A living 2D casino in the browser: walk the floor, sit down next to other players and NPCs, and play alongside dealers at a real table's pace. The successor to Python Casino.

title: Python Casino
summary: The foundation for Casino World. Nine table games in pure Python with no assets or installs. Its rules engines now drive every card game in Casino World, and it still runs standalone on anything with Python.

title: Star EPR
summary: A practice ground for Mirth and MSSQL, hooked up to a web page front-end. Needs writing up, but after doing this for 40-60 hours a week for my real job it's hard to find the drive to work on it.
